rows.text: calls, in order, a 5-byte thunk with `ecx = 0`, a 17-byte dword setter with `ecx = -1` (it stores `0xB4` for a non-positive argument), a 13-byte two-global setter with `ecx = 0` and `edx = 0`, a 38-byte routine, a 7-byte dword setter with `ecx = 1`, and tail-jumps a second 7-byte dword setter with `ecx = 1`
when qword `[rcx + 0xC0]` is non-null, replaces bit 5 of its byte `+0x151` with bit 0 of `dl`; otherwise returns without a store
when qword `[rcx + 0xC0]` is non-null, replaces bit 4 of its byte `+0x151` with bit 0 of `dl`; otherwise returns without a store
when qword `[rcx + 0xC0]` is non-null, sets bit 7 of its byte `+0x151` to 1 when `edx` is nonzero and to 0 otherwise; with a null pointer it returns without a store
returns bit 1 of byte `+0x14F` of qword `[rcx + 0xC0]`, or 0 when that pointer is null

returns at once for a null `rcx`, a null `[rcx + 0xC0]` (the sub) or a sub whose dword `+0` is -1; otherwise it takes bit 1 of the sub's byte `+0x14F` as a flag, forced to 1 when the sub's signed byte `+0x12` is at least `0x10`, and when the sub's word `+0` is not -1 and the `0x740`-byte record at that index under qword `022C6F28` has a nonzero dword `+0x284` it passes the record and the flag to a 392-byte routine; then it calls a 109-byte routine with byte `[rcx + 0x15]` and word `[rcx]`

returns at once for a null `rcx`, a null `[rcx + 0xC0]` (the sub) or a sub whose dword `+0` is -1; otherwise it takes bit 1 of the sub's byte `+0x14F` as a flag, forced to 1 when the sub's signed byte `+0x12` is at least `0x10`, and when the sub's word `+0` is not -1 and the `0x740`-byte record at that index under qword `022C6F28` has a nonzero dword `+0x284` it sets that record's byte `+0x40B` to `(byte AND 0xFD) OR 1` for a nonzero flag or clears its bits 0 and 1 for a zero flag; every non-returning path tail-jumps a 109-byte routine with byte `[rcx + 0x15]` and word `[rcx]`

pops an index through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`, fills a four-entry stack array through an 11-byte collector called with `edx = 4` and, when the index is below (signed) the returned count, the array entry is non-null and a 50-byte check on `(rdx, entry)` returns nonzero, calls a 27-byte routine with the entry and `edx = 1`; any failed test returns without that call

resolves `rdx` through two 44-byte resolvers (the mode-2 one into `rsi`, the mode-1 one into `rbx`), calls the 26-byte bit-1-of-`+0x14F` getter on `rbx` (result unused), sets a flag to `WorldActor_QueryCombatStanceState(rsi) != 0`, calls a 65-byte flag setter on `(rbx, 0, 0)`, a 65-byte routine on `rbx` with `xmm1 = 0.0` and a 65-byte routine on `(rbx, flag, 1)`, then tail-jumps the 39-byte setter of bit 1 of byte `+0x14F` with `(rsi, flag)`

pops a value through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`, passes `(rdx, value)` to a 34-byte setter of bits 1 and 2 of byte `[rdx + 8]`, reads the three position floats of `rdx` through `Actor_GetWorldPosition` into stack slots and calls `002E5DF0(rdx)` with them in `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3`

reads a global qword through an 8-byte getter, pops a value through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)` and passes `(that qword, rcx, value)` to a 206-byte routine; then pops a second value and tail-jumps the 43-byte setter that stores its third argument (the routine's result) to qword `+0x120 + 8 * index` of `[rdx + 0xC0]` and ORs 4 into its byte `+0x14F`, with `rdx` and the second value as the actor and index

resolves `rdx` through two 44-byte resolvers (mode 2 then mode 1) and returns 0 when a 56-byte check on the first is zero; otherwise it steps the word state `[r8]`: 0 and 1 store 2 and run state 2, which stores 3 when a 208-byte test on the mode-1 actor is zero; 3 stores the actor's bit 1 of `+0x14F` to dword `+8` and stores 4, calling 65-byte routines and the 39-byte `+0x14F` bit-1 setter with flag 0 when byte `+2` is nonzero, else with flag 1; 4 stores 5 and runs state 5 when the 208-byte test is zero (with byte `+2` nonzero also when a 78-byte float getter is at least 16.0, storing 1 to byte `+3`); 5 calls a 108-byte routine with dword `+0xC` and 4.0 (0.0 when byte `+3` is zero) only when dword `+4` is nonzero, and stores 7; any other state changes nothing; it returns 1 unless the state is 7

reads dwords `02EC0B24` and `02EC0B28`, sets bits 2 and 3 in both when `ecx` is nonzero or clears them when it is zero, passes the low word of the first to a 12-byte word setter and of the second to an 8-byte word setter, and stores both values back to `02EC0B24` and `02EC0B28`

walks the dword `02EBCBC0` (signed count, none when not positive) qword entries of `02EBCAC0`: each entry is resolved through a 44-byte resolver, and when the 16-byte getter of the resolved actor's `+0xC0` pointer returns non-null it replaces bit 1 of that block's byte `+0x10` with bit 0 of `ecx` and calls `Actor_RefreshPresentationVisibility` on the resolved actor

returns for a null `rcx`; otherwise resolves it through a 44-byte resolver into the actor and gets a record through a 38-byte lookup (returning when null), then calls on the actor `Actor_SetDesiredMovementHeading` with float `+0x34`, `Actor_SetFacingHeading_Variant1` with float `+0x24`, `Actor_SetDesiredMovementHeading` again with `+0x34`, `0026B0C0` with floats `+0`, `+4`, `+8`, `0026B720` with floats `+0x10`, `+0x14`, `+0x18`, `0026ACE0` with 0, a 26-byte setter with the signed byte `+0x64`, and `002E4A40`

when a 117-byte lookup returns non-null, passes qword `+0x10` of the result with `edx = 0` to a 34-byte setter of bits 1 and 2 of its byte `+8`, then tail-jumps `0026B0C0` with that qword and 0.0 in `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3`; a null result returns without either call
